description: This file contains unit tests for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. Specifically, it tests fetching, updating, and deletion of time configuration periods via the API, using a PHPUnit testing framework with mock dependencies.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI, testing getOne, update, delete, and validation rule retrieval.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a time configuration period by ID, including fixture setup and mocking authentication.

methods.name: getOnePreHook
methods.description: Preparatory hook that adjusts configuration before executing the getOne test case, specifically for scenarios involving timesheet period updates.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for testGetOne, sourcing test cases from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a time configuration period, mocking user authentication and verifying API behavior.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for testUpdate, sourcing from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete operation is not implemented and throws appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete operation is not implemented.
